study.title: NextGen Cassava tricot trial in Tanzania (Pwani, Tanga and Morogoro)
study.description: On-farm tricot evaluation of 18 Kibaha (KBH) cassava clones with the varieties Mkuranga 1 and Kizimbani in 20 villages of six districts (Kilindi and Handeni in Tanga, Chalinze and Mkuranga in Pwani, Morogoro Rural and Kilosa in Morogoro), planted between 18 March and 1 May 2020. Farmers ranked the clones at 1, 3, 6, 9 and 12 months after planting. 200 packages were distributed and 115 farmers returned rankings. Data produced by the Tanzania Agricultural Research Institute (TARI) with Cornell University under NextGen Cassava. Participant gender was inferred from first names in TARI's field sheet; names that do not show gender are left blank. The source holds one coordinate per district, so farm coordinates are not published.

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point. Sites without coordinates take the mean of other sites in the same adm3 before rounding.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept, with spacing and capitalisation standardised
location_privacy.gap_filling: Sites without a point take the mean of located sites with the same administrative names, pooled across all published trials (adm2+adm3, then adm3, then adm2, within 30 km of their mean), before rounding. coordinate_source names the level, coordinate_uncertainty_m adds the spread of the pool.
